lanes.detail: pure decider + 20-assertion guard suite, itself registered in TESTS; a suite file on disk with no written verdict is RED, an exemption with no reason FAILS, a deferred verdict expires after 14 days, and a ledger entry that no longer describes the disk is red too. 70 unregistered files recorded with a reason, 65 of them reading green standalone
